- **Why it may be wrong:** 25 August had already passed when Pree posted it. I asked Pree whether they meant a different date or next year, and nobody has answered.
- **Nothing to check it against:** there are no Tansley Parcel files on the share.
- **What I read:** only #central-team, after checking that Hollis is a member. A signing deadline isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share there.

One thing to fix: my summary from last time was also posted into #central-team as a separate message (ts 1791986400.000125). It doesn't leak anything, but it's clutter. I can't delete messages, so someone may want to remove it by hand.
